scope: Typed operation signatures for request plans: consumed and produced artifact kinds, effects and evidence-basis contributions. Every registered mode has an entry; ravel.validation.signature_conformance checks each one. A plan node whose operation has no entry contributes the unclassified basis and a CHECK-IN 1 flag. A signature declares shape, not scientific validity.
